caption: 01 · ORIGIN — What is the earliest reliable record?. Preserve native file, physical notebook or sample, creator, date basis, device or system context, identifier, and custody. Distinguish recorded time from an unverified recollection.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what is the earliest reliable record? within Proof of Making.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · CHANGE — Can development be reconstructed?. Link versions, annotations, patterns, fittings, samples, approvals, and rejected alternatives. Keep contributor corrections and disagreements rather than overwriting them.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping can development be reconstructed? within Proof of Making.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · RIGHT — What does the evidence not decide?. Separate factual creation history from U.S. copyright authorship, work-made-for-hire, transfer, contract, patent, design, trademark, foreign-law, and confidentiality questions.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what does the evidence not decide? within Proof of Making.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · CUSTODY — Can the chain survive movement?. Record every deposit, handoff, copy, migration, sale, loan, publication, return, and deletion with responsible person and integrity check.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping can the chain survive movement? within Proof of Making.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
